title: Twenty-three years
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-three. The corn. The last anniversary the public strip draws. It doesn't know it's the last. The reader will.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn. WOOD, forty. BARNABY II, six, in the bed. #1 on the wall. The ochre wash of Era IV in the light already.

panels.composition: The corn. The tray. Twenty-three trays.

panels.composition: Wood, to the dog. The shortest anniversary line he's ever said.

panels.composition: Alone at the long surface. Corn. Dog. #1. The last time. The panel doesn't know. The reader does.
